$comment: Fake deployment scenario of the standalone robot_runtime (--fake-scenario).
Feedback that never moves: the two configured joints stay at zero with valid,
connected samples and accepted writes, for the whole life of the process.
tests/support/fake_scenario.json is the same for its first two seconds and
then steps the measured position to 0.05 rad, which is outside the shipped
towards the configured target leaves that tolerance satisfied, so a *repeated*
initialization can complete again here and cannot with the stepping scenario.
elapsed_us is monotonic from process start and mandatory; an entry applies from
its time onwards. One entry is enough: nothing has to change.
imu.valid is false because imu_required is false in the shipped configuration.
